summary: Frontend-only polish-pass validation (iteration 3). Executed 28 functional checks across Dashboard, Command Palette, Live Session (RadialCommittee + AgentDrillModal), Toast system, Clients index, and Client Profile. 27/28 passed on first run; 1 critical interaction bug (thought-stream buttons non-clickable) was identified, root-caused, fixed by the testing agent, and re-verified. All acceptance criteria from the request now satisfy.
action_items: Optional: audit any other usage of `cw-scanlines` where the class is placed directly on a container that has interactive children (there is one more occurrence on LiveSession.jsx line ~194 but it is applied to an absolute overlay — safe). Good going forward to ALWAYS apply the class to a pure decorative overlay div, never to a container with children that need to be clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: CSS class `cw-scanlines` sets `pointer-events: none` on the element it is applied to, which also neutralizes all descendant pointer interactions (unless children set `pointer-events: auto`). In LiveSession.jsx:363 the class was applied to the flex scroll container wrapping the stream lines and their agent buttons — this blocked the documented feature 'stream line agent names are clickable'. The pattern should be: decorative scanline effect should live inside a sibling absolute `inset-0` overlay div, not on a real content container. Fix applied.

CommandPalette + AgentDrillModal keyboard handling is good (Esc/Arrow/Enter). Focus trap is basic — modal/scrim does not return focus to the origin element on close, which is a minor a11y concern but not blocking.

Radial committee uses nested `<g onClick>` inside another `<g onClick>` (duplicate click handler on outer group and on inner group). Functionally harmless but redundant — outer group handler is sufficient.
RightRail approval queue mutates source data via local state copy — fine for mocked demo; real backend integration later must guard against optimistic UI rollback on API failure.
Dashboard heatmap markup is correct (7 rows x 24 cols produced); test suite only counted generic `<rect>` for the SVG chart and still saw cells — visually verified in screenshots.
Client profile page lacks a data-testid for the compliance-history rail column and Quick-actions block — nice-to-have for future regression testing.

rca of the issue: Bug: Thought-stream agent names failed to open AgentDrillModal. Reproduction: navigate /council/live/CW-2041, wait for streamed lines to render, click agent button inside any stream-line-<i>. Expected: AgentDrillModal opens for that agent. Observed before fix: Playwright detected pointer events intercepted by `div[data-testid='thought-stream']`; real users in a browser would also not be able to click. Root cause: class `cw-scanlines` (defined in /app/frontend/src/index.css:205) has `pointer-events: none` on the element itself, and it was applied directly to the scrollable wrapper containing the interactive buttons. `pointer-events: none` on a parent makes it and all its descendants unclickable unless descendants explicitly opt back in. Mitigation applied: in /app/frontend/src/pages/LiveSession.jsx at the stream container (was line 363), removed `cw-scanlines` from the wrapper and instead added a sibling absolutely-positioned decorative overlay `<div className='cw-scanlines absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none' aria-hidden='true' />`. Re-tested: clicking 'Scholar' / 'Historian' / 'RetirementPlanner' stream buttons now opens the matching AgentDrillModal. Preventive guidance: treat `cw-scanlines` as an overlay-only class; never attach to a content container.
